text: {"name":"tx_packet_batch_add","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Appends a descriptor to the active transmit batch, tracks its accumulated counters, and submits and clears the batch when the configured threshold is reached.","subsystem":"tx","var_renames":{"v1":"batch_state","v3":"batch_progress","v4":"batch_total","v5":"current_descriptor"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Per-call amount accumulated into the batch total"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Current descriptor pointer passed to the submit routine"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Per-call progress accumulated toward the submission threshold"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Head descriptor or value for the active batch"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Accumulated batch total"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Descriptor pointer whose link is set when appending"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Accumulated progress used for the threshold check"},{"offset":33,"meaning":"Batch-active flag"}]}
